what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.how_to_attend: Hybrid: in person at LMS Room D132 or on Zoom (https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83227847126, Meeting ID 832 2784 7126); broadcast later on local access cable, Facebook and YouTube

items.why_it_matters: The committee reviews the bills the district paid over this period.

items.agenda_line: a. In Person Interview Richard Mathieu, Director of Finance and Operations(3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee interviews a candidate for the district's finance and operations director position.

items.agenda_line: b. Removal of Surplus Material (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee may act on disposing of district property listed as surplus.

items.agenda_line: c. Beginning of Year Data Presentation (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The district presents start-of-year data on its schools.

items.agenda_line: d. COTA Position Change to .5 OT (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A change to a certified occupational therapy assistant position is up for action, which touches school staffing.

items.agenda_line: e. Brooks House Redevelopment Proposal (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A redevelopment proposal for the Brooks House building is on the agenda, with the town planning director listed as a guest.

items.agenda_line: f. Amendment of School Calendar-Parent/Teacher Conferences (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The school calendar may change for parent/teacher conferences, affecting families' schedules.
The committee hears a report on fall sports.

items.agenda_line: h. Vote an Amount to Fund the Special Education Reserve Fund Approved at November 2026 Town Meeting (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: The committee may vote an amount for the Special Education Reserve Fund tied to the November 2026 Town Meeting.

items.agenda_line: j. Discussion of Track & Field (Turf) Future Costs
items.why_it_matters: Future costs of the track and field turf are up for discussion, which bears on facility spending.

items.agenda_line: a. Revised Paraprofessional Salary Schedule (3 min)
items.why_it_matters: A revised pay schedule for paraprofessionals is up for action, which bears on staffing costs.

preview.hook: Special education reserve fund vote, paraprofessional pay schedule, Brooks House proposal and turf future costs
preview.one_line: School Committee, Oct 7, 7pm (hybrid): special education reserve fund amount, revised paraprofessional salary schedule, Brooks House proposal, turf costs, finance director interview.
